verdict.rationale: Pilot is a bookkeeping, tax and CFO service with a customer portal, so asking whether it offers API parity with that UI is a fair question. The evidence shows no public customer-facing API at all, and every OpenAPI probe path returned 404. The cited integrations (Bill.com, Stripe, Gusto, banks) are data sources Pilot connects to, not a programmatic interface that lets users do what they can do in the portal.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
